children: Piedmont Realty Trust issued $230 million of 2.875% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2031 under a new indenture, including $30 million of option notes, to refinance higher-cost debt and bolster liquidity. The notes, guaranteed by the company, carry an initial exchange rate of 79.0514 shares per $1,000 (implying a $12.65 exchange price) and standard redemption and make-whole provisions. Proceeds, together with other sources, will fund the redemption of the company’s 9.250% senior notes due 2028 and related costs; Piedmont also repurchased about 5.4 million shares in concurrent private transactions. The company separately executed a Registration Rights Agreement to support resales of shares issuable upon note exchanges, with remedies for delays beyond defined limits.
